verdict.rationale: Linear's own Linear Agent takes plain-language instructions across several surfaces. Loops are described in plain language and run on a schedule or in response to an event, the agent edits text and drafts updates, the project composer develops ideas with the agent, and the agent can triage, plan, review and ship code. An official MCP server also lets Claude and Cursor drive Linear conversationally. Missing for 10: documentation that the core workspace (creating, filtering and updating issues, views and cycles) can be fully operated through natural-language commands, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how reliable natural-language operation is.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
